arxiv.abstract: Multi-robot systems face the challenge of efficiently allocating teams of heterogeneous robots to tasks. arxiv.abstract: Language-guided UAV navigation has largely focused on long-horizon route planning, leaving short-range, object-relative flight maneuvers underexplored. arxiv.title: XBot-Omni: An Omni-Modal Model for Embodied Understanding and Interaction
arxiv.abstract: Embodied interaction requires an agent to integrate multimodal perception with verbal and nonverbal behaviors to effectively communicate its intentions, including speech, body motion, and facial expressions. arxiv.title: Inner Product Regularization for Imitation Learning
arxiv.abstract: Robots that learn from demonstrations should extrapolate their policy despite state perturbations such as sensor noise, scene variation, and compounding errors. arxiv.title: FORGE: Force-Aware Multi-Granularity Control for Efficient Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
arxiv.abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated locomotion, balance regulation, and manipulation under frequent contacts, making teleoperated demonstration collection difficult: a practical controller must simultaneously provide precision, stability, and contact awareness. arxiv.abstract: Embodied foundation models hinge on diverse robot interaction data, which are costly to collect. arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can supply autonomous systems with plans, predictions, and judgments, but these contributions are sometimes wrong. arxiv.abstract: Nonlinear time-optimal model predictive control (TOMPC) enables highly performant control of constrained systems, but its computational cost prohibits real-time use on fast dynamical systems. arxiv.abstract: The growing volume of process data generated by screwdriving systems, combined with advancements in computing power, data storage, and algorithms, is facilitating the application of artificial intelligence in this field. arxiv.abstract: Model architecture shapes the scaling behavior, training efficiency, and inference cost of LLMs, making it a central focus of both industry and academia. arxiv.abstract: Institutional portfolios operate under investment policy statements that specify asset allocation constraints, often conditioned on market regime information. arxiv.abstract: Applying machine learning systems to new domains introduces bottlenecks in both labeled data acquisition and manual pipeline engineering. arxiv.abstract: Humans can learn rapidly from limited experience, while neural networks typically require extensive training. In this work, we investigate what properties of a neural network can enable it to learn rapidly. arxiv.abstract: Context attribution asks how removing parts of a prompt changes a language model's output. arxiv.title: Classical Energies Learn to Reason 1,000x Faster than Looped Models
arxiv.abstract: Looped models have emerged as a prominent paradigm for reasoning, with successes on simple reasoning puzzles such as Sudoku-Extreme and Maze-Unique. arxiv.abstract: Debate has been recently proposed as a training protocol that is hoped to produce more aligned models even as model capabilities scale. arxiv.abstract: We investigate whether and how LLMs encode goals: internal neural representations that precede and guide action, and that are flexible enough to be realized through many different execution paths. arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically relies on a verifier that can reliably judge whether sampled solutions are correct. arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated the ability to generate parameters for variational quantum circuits without conventional optimization. arxiv.abstract: Digitizing handwritten chess scoresheets has been studied as a handwriting-recognition problem: read the move in each box and check that it is legal. arxiv.abstract: Today's AI workloads are rapidly changing: new models are released more often, model architectures are increasingly diverse, and traffic distributions change frequently. arxiv.abstract: Observational causal discovery often leaves causal di- rections unresolved or unstable. arxiv.abstract: Current benchmarks for LLM-driven data agents saturate quickly and cannot target specific capabilities. arxiv.title: Rational Use of Time for Social Coordination in Humans and AI
arxiv.abstract: All social interactions are situated in time. Previous studies have shown that humans are able to use implicit temporal cues, such as the duration of a pause, to infer others' mental states. arxiv.title: Leaderboard Hacking: Preference-Based Model Evaluations are Vulnerable to Manipulation
arxiv.abstract: Arena-style rankings of language models are a widely used evaluation framework in online leaderboards, research papers, and model evaluation in production. arxiv.title: Robust Task-Aware State Estimation from Pre-trained Perception
arxiv.abstract: Agents that perform state estimation using pretrained perception models, e.g., Vision-Language Models (VLMs), face the fundamental challenge that predictions are uncertain. arxiv.abstract: Proof-step verification rewrites a solver's answer into typed steps and uses LLM judges to certify or decline. We evaluate this pipeline on open-weight models across GPQA, AIME-2025, and a MATH-500 subset. arxiv.abstract: Costly simulations and experiments limit the data available for engineering design. This paper proposes GenPFN, a training-free candidate generator guided by a pretrained tabular Prior-Data Fitted Network (TabPFN) classifier with fixed weights. arxiv.abstract: Many advances in ML systems came from breaking an assumption that earlier methods took for granted: speculative decoding dropped the assumption that a model needs one forward pass per token. arxiv.abstract: Agentic AI systems increasingly undertake extended tasks and act on people's behalf, making human-agent interaction central to their effectiveness. arxiv.abstract: Forward-KL language-model distillation normally computes dense teacher and student scores over the full vocabulary at every supervised position, making training and stored teacher targets expensive. arxiv.abstract: When we judge that our reasoning was defective, it seems plausible that we should abandon the conclusion it produced. arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) require frequent knowledge updates across heterogeneous domains, but existing editing methods fail when applied sequentially to multi-task settings. arxiv.abstract: Frontier video generation models work in a VAE latent space that compresses video in both space and time. arxiv.abstract: Spatial intelligence requires connecting visual observations to the geometry, objects, and persistent state of an environment. arxiv.abstract: Hyperspectral images (HSI) possess discriminating spectral characteristics with respect to land utilization due to high-dimensional information. arxiv.abstract: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) has emerged as a leading paradigm for distilling diffusion models into few-step students, where an auxiliary fake score model tracks the student's distribution and the discrepancy between the teacher and fake predictions drives the student toward the teacher. arxiv.title: Consensus Capture in Reference-Based UAV Video Stabilization: A Benchmark on Dynamic Urban Scenes
arxiv.abstract: Reference-frame stabilization registers every frame of a hovering-drone video onto one reference frame, keeping object positions comparable. arxiv.abstract: Within the CG animation production pipeline, the challenges artists tackle in Lighting can be immense. arxiv.title: Validation-Guided Prompt Selection for Differential Morphing Attack Detection
arxiv.abstract: Differential morphing attack detection (D-MAD) compares a trusted live capture with a document image that may contain a facial morph. hf_papers.title: Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation
hf_papers.abstract: LingBot-Touch is a tactile foundation model that learns a unified, extensible representation across heterogeneous tactile sensors, yielding plug-and-play tactile tokens that consistently enhance manipulation policies such as diffusion policy and VLA models.

hf_papers.title: WorldFoundry: Towards Unified Infrastructure for World Intelligence
hf_papers.abstract: WorldFoundry offers open-source infrastructure for reproducible inference and evaluation of generative world models across video, 3D/4D, embodied action, and interactive systems, with traceable evidence and benchmarks.

hf_papers.title: World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation
hf_papers.abstract: Trained action policies write manipulation skill into network weights, tying what is learned to the distribution it is learned from. hf_papers.title: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
hf_papers.abstract: We introduce Sage-Taiyi, a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific understanding to guide what to investigate next and how to investigate it. hf_papers.title: Toward the Era of Agentic Embodied Intelligence
hf_papers.abstract: An embodied multi-agent framework uses learned correction codes and a vision-language-action model with motion-aware history and latent world modeling to improve robot control, failure recovery, and training efficiency.

hf_papers.title: BirdDreams: Joint Perspective and BEV Video Generation for a Plausible, Reactive Driving World Model
hf_papers.abstract: Driving world models aim to simulate how a scene unfolds under different ego actions. hf_papers.title: Duo: A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction
hf_papers.abstract: A reciprocal world model enables real-time full-duplex audiovisual interaction by jointly modeling intent and realization using autoregressive reasoning, synchronized attention, and dual rollout distillation.

hf_papers.abstract: Large foundation models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 have recently been shown to control robots directly from visual observations. hf_papers.title: DexForesight: Grounding Dexterous Policies with Implicit Spatial Foresight
hf_papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation requires rich spatial foresight over both the surrounding scene and the robot hand. Existing world-action models often acquire such predictive knowledge through explicit future prediction. hf_papers.title: SWAM: Scaling World Action Models with Cross-Modal Alignment
hf_papers.abstract: World action models jointly predict video and actions conditioned on language. Existing studies focus primarily on architectures and training mechanisms, typically treating language-video alignment acquired through video pretraining as an established foundation. hf_papers.title: Exploring Weight-Space Programming: Capabilities, Generalization, and Limitations
hf_papers.abstract: Weight-Space Programming can produce large localized accuracy gains and uneven cross-task transfer, but reliable editing remains inconsistent.

hf_papers.title: How Many Exposures Does a World Model Need? Learning Unseen Game Mechanics at Test Time
hf_papers.abstract: World models enable agents to plan and learn from imagined experience, but in an unfamiliar environment they must learn its mechanics from limited interaction. hf_papers.title: ProTEUS: A mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution
hf_papers.abstract: ProTEUS is a mutation-resolved world model that combines sequence, evolutionary, and structural representations with fast all-atom prediction and closed-loop feedback to guide protein evolution and improve mutant activity.

hf_papers.title: Interactive Visual Gym: Evaluating Visual Interaction Models with Simulated Users in Interactive Worlds
hf_papers.abstract: Interactive Visual Gym enables closed-loop evaluation and training of visual interaction models by jointly simulating task environments and human users, exposing limitations in state-of-the-art VLMs and improving performance through closed-loop training.

hf_papers.title: UniSpark: Exploring Hybrid Attention for Multimodal Understanding and Generation
hf_papers.abstract: We present UniSpark-9B, a unified multimodal model that investigates hybrid attention for visual understanding and generation. hf_papers.title: SIRIS: Can LLMs Tell When Simulation Errors Matter in AI-Driven Systems Research
hf_papers.abstract: A benchmark probes whether large language models can determine when imperfect simulator limitations invalidate recommended system designs, finding that identifying a limitation does not ensure correct design choices and that review-based self-correction yields mixed results.

hf_papers.title: Is Your Robot's Memory Just a Clock? Temporal Shortcuts in Memory-Augmented VLA Policies
hf_papers.abstract: Memory in vision-language-action policies can mistake pauses for progress because it is indexed by time, causing early stopping, while event-based indexing mitigates this without retraining.

hf_papers.title: Auriga Technical Report: A Task-Agnostic Agent Harness for Zero-Shot Embodied Manipulation
hf_papers.abstract: Auriga, a task-agnostic agent harness, closes most of the planning-execution gap in zero-shot robot manipulation by combining explicit task beliefs, calibrated 3D measurements, dual-arm control, and execution monitoring, achieving state-of-the-art results on RoboDojo and RoboCasa365.

RoboScript 让操作策略在当前世界中以示范进行上下文学习，尝试解除技能与训练分布的强绑定：[规划层]
A2-MEAS 将纠错语言、运动历史和潜在世界模型接入 VLA 的训练与运行时，聚焦长任务失败恢复：[端到端VLA]

items.title: A2-MEAS：以纠错码提升 VLA 的恢复能力
items.summary: 该框架将学习到的纠错语言、运动感知历史与潜在世界模型接入 VLA，在训练监督和运行时共同修正动作提案，面向控制失败恢复；代码已公开。[端到端VLA]

items.title: SWAM：以跨模态对齐扩展世界动作模型
items.summary: 研究语言条件下联合预测视频与动作的世界动作模型，指出引入动作学习会破坏既有语言-视频对齐，并提出数据与监督设计来维持该基础能力；代码已公开。[端到端VLA]

items.title: VLA 记忆的时间捷径问题
items.summary: 研究发现按时间索引的记忆会把停顿误判为任务进度而导致提前结束，采用事件索引可在不重训模型的条件下缓解这一问题；代码已公开。[端到端VLA]

items.title: LingBot-Touch：统一异构触觉表征服务灵巧操作
items.summary: 触觉基础模型从多种传感器学习统一、可扩展的表示，生成可插拔触觉 token 以增强扩散策略、VLA 与 pi0.5 等操作策略，降低跨传感器迁移成本；代码已公开。[感知层]

items.title: RoboScript：在当前世界中进行操作上下文学习
items.summary: 方法将示范中的语义经验与机器人当前所处世界的反馈结合，以 in-context learning 执行操作技能，试图突破已训练策略对原始训练分布的绑定；代码已公开。[规划层]

items.title: FORGE：力感知的多粒度人形移操控制
items.summary: 面向频繁接触下的人形移动与操作协同，提出从速度导航到精细接触的粗到细命令空间，统一处理平衡、精度与接触感知。[控制层·BC]

items.title: Ropedia Xperience 2：扩展物理 AI 的环境与行为基准
items.summary: 项目同时提供人类行为示范和可交互环境，针对长视野、接触丰富的真实任务补足数据与评测资源；代码已公开。[控制层·世界模型]

items.title: 实时神经模仿时间最优 MPC
items.summary: 以神经网络模仿非线性时间最优模型预测控制律，目标是在受约束快速动力学系统中降低在线控制计算成本，为仿真优化策略落地实时系统提供路径。[控制层·BC]

domains.name: 具身模型（感知/规划/控制三层 × 动作生成方式）

items.title: WorldFoundry：世界模型的可复现评测基础设施
items.summary: 开源系统覆盖视频、3D/4D、具身动作与交互式系统的生成世界模型推理和评测，并以可追溯证据与基准组织结果；代码已公开。[控制层·世界模型]

items.title: BirdDreams：视角与鸟瞰联合建模的驾驶世界模型
items.summary: 为兼顾周边车辆运动合理性和自车轨迹可控性，联合生成透视与 BEV 视频，并以布局条件降低遮挡与外观耦合造成的预测困难。[控制层·世界模型]

items.title: ProtoVis-Nav：视觉想象辅助无人机语言导航
items.summary: 针对三维飞行中航点预测误差会导致碰撞的问题，以原型化视觉想象估计执行结果，使语言指令与视觉空间导航对齐。[规划层]

domains.name: 具身智能芯片（机器人计算 / 边缘 NPU）

items.title: ScrewSense：拧紧工序的异常检测与错误分类
items.summary: 利用螺钉拧紧系统积累的过程数据识别并分类工艺错误，目标是减少返工、保障产品质量，并将 AI 质量控制嵌入制造流程。[感知层]

items.title: Agility Robotics 发布面向规模化应用的 Digit 5
items.summary: 公司联合创始人在 IEEE Spectrum 介绍 Digit 5，定位为可安全、经济地大规模执行有用工作的类人机器人；具体规格与部署进度以官方渠道核验。[市场/产业]

items.title: GENTO 从传感器栈切入人形与灵巧手
items.summary: 媒体报道 Tianji Intelligence 在 CoRL 展示人形机器人和新灵巧手，强调以长期构建的传感器与部件栈支撑系统集成；产品能力以官方渠道核验。[市场/产业]

funding.title: Humble Robotics 获 5,100 万美元 A 轮扩展自主电动货运
funding.summary: 媒体报道该公司完成 5,100 万美元 A 轮，用于扩展货运自主驾驶业务；融资与商业化进展以公司官方渠道核验。

funding.title: Neura Robotics 与 E.ON 合作试点能源基础设施人形机器人
funding.summary: 双方计划面向电网巡检和监测开发 Physical AI 应用，首批真实场景试验计划在 2027 年开展；合作细节以官方渠道核验。
